title: First-Principles LLM Capacity Sizing (Roofline / 6ND / KV Cache), XProf/Nsight Profiling & Goodput Triage Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Blind Trial-and-Error Scaling (No Roofline Math, Unbucketed Shapes & Co-Located P/D)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: 21.5% MFU × 58.0% Goodput = 12.5% real cluster yield ($2.65M/mo)

tiers.name: Tier 2: Coarse Chip-Busy Monitoring Only (Ignores Rollback Badput & Exposed Collectives)
tiers.verdict: Chips look 95% 'busy' spinning on non-overlapped DCN AllReduce & recomputing lost steps

tiers.name: Tier 3: Static Shape Bucketing Only (Co-Located Prefill/Decode & Synchronous Checkpoints)
tiers.verdict: Fixes XLA recompiles, but long-prompt Prefills stall Decode TPOT & sync saves drop Goodput

tiers.name: Tier 4: Roofline-Sized + XProf/Nsight Async Collective Overlap + 3-Factor Goodput + P/D Split
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 59.2% MFU × 96.5% Goodput = 57.1% real yield (4.57x Tier 1) & -78.1% TCO
